cohort: A 31-year-old woman admitted to a surgical unit with post-cesarean hematoma.
finding: Whole genome sequencing confirmed the presence of the blaNDM-1 gene, encoding New Delhi metallo-beta-lactamase-1, in a Tn125 transposon integrated on a plasmid, conferring resistance to multiple antibiotics, in a strain of Acinetobacter baumannii isolated from a patient in Benin.
